english.title: Fail to cause a vehicle to remain at the prescribed distance from any other vehicle within a Mersey Tunnel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

failed to cause the vehicle when

(C)_[moving to remain a clear spacing from a vehicle ahead of not less than 23 metres]_
(D)_[stationary to maintain a clear spacing from a vehicle ahead of not less than 2.75 metres]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(n) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas
failed to cause the vehicle when moving
to remain a clear spacing from a vehicle ahead of not less than 23 metres OR
when stationary
to maintain a clear spacing from a vehicle ahead of not less than 2.75 metres
